from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    fill=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color: color forming full separator rows/cols
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 or all(grid[r][c]!=fill for c in range(W))]
    # better: rows that contain no fill
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=fill for c in range(W))]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=fill for r in range(H))]
    line=grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else None
    # markers: cells not fill and not line
    M={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if grid[r][c] not in (fill,line): M[(r,c)]=grid[r][c]
    maxr=max(r for r,_ in M); maxc=max(c for _,c in M)
    rs=[r for r in sep_rows if r<=maxr]; cs=[c for c in sep_cols if c<=maxc]
    # bands between consecutive separator lines, but include band from first sep line
    # determine band starts: use sep lines strictly inside [0,maxr]
    rbs=rs; cbs=cs
    nR=len(rbs)-1 if len(rbs)>1 else 1
    nC=len(cbs)-1 if len(cbs)>1 else 1
    out=[[fill]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(rbs[i],cbs[j]),(rbs[i],cbs[j+1]),(rbs[i+1],cbs[j]),(rbs[i+1],cbs[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv)==4 and len(set(cv))==1: out[i][j]=cv[0]
    return out

for i,p in enumerate(pairs):
    o=transform(p['input'])
    print(i, o==p['output'], o, p['output'])

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    fill=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=fill for c in range(W))]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=fill for r in range(H))]
    line=Counter(grid[sep_rows[0]]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c] not in (fill,line)}
    maxr=max(r for r,_ in M); maxc=max(c for _,c in M)
    rbs=[r for r in sep_rows if r<=maxr]; cbs=[c for c in sep_cols if c<=maxc]
    nR,nC=len(rbs)-1,len(cbs)-1
    out=[[fill]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(rbs[i],cbs[j]),(rbs[i],cbs[j+1]),(rbs[i+1],cbs[j]),(rbs[i+1],cbs[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv)==4 and len(set(cv))==1: out[i][j]=cv[0]
    return out
